regions.name: Desert Southwest
visual_identifiers: sparse desert scrub and Joshua trees
very dry bare soil or sand

state_distinguishers.Arizona_vs_NewMexico: Saguaro cactus only grows in Arizona. New Mexico has more juniper and pinon pine. Arizona roads often have distinctive brown highway signs.
state_distinguishers.Nevada_vs_Utah: Utah has iconic red/orange rock formations. Nevada desert is more grey-brown with sagebrush. Las Vegas-style infrastructure visible in Nevada.
state_distinguishers.Utah_vs_Arizona: Utah has more dramatic red rock canyon scenery. Arizona flatter with saguaro.

regions.route_sign_clues: Arizona uses dark brown signs. Utah has unique beehive state route shape. Nevada has distinctive silver/blue signs.
regions.gemini_hint: Saguaro cactus = almost certainly Arizona. Dramatic red canyon rock = likely Utah. Flat grey sagebrush desert = likely Nevada.

regions.name: Pacific Northwest
visual_identifiers: dense dark green Douglas fir and conifer forests
wet environment with moss on surfaces

state_distinguishers.Washington_vs_Oregon: Extremely hard to distinguish visually. Washington has more volcanic peak visibility (Mount Rainier). Oregon coast more accessible. Look for WA vs OR route prefixes on signs.

regions.route_sign_clues: Washington route signs have WA prefix. Oregon use OR prefix. Both use standard green highway signs.
regions.gemini_hint: Dense dark conifers with moss and overcast sky = Pacific Northwest. Volcanic peak visible = likely Washington.

regions.name: Great Plains
visual_identifiers: extremely flat terrain extending to horizon
very wide open sky taking up most of image

state_distinguishers.Kansas_vs_Nebraska: Very hard. Kansas slightly more southern feel, Oklahoma border has more red soil. Nebraska has more Sandhills terrain in west.
state_distinguishers.North_vs_South_Dakota: Badlands terrain = South Dakota western region. Flat farmland could be either.

regions.route_sign_clues: Each state has unique route sign shape. Kansas uses a sunflower outline. Nebraska plain rectangle. Oklahoma uses arrow shape.
regions.gemini_hint: Completely flat grain fields to horizon = Great Plains. Badlands red/grey eroded terrain = western South Dakota.

regions.name: Rocky Mountain West
visual_identifiers: wide open valleys between mountain ranges
gravel or unpaved roads common in rural areas

state_distinguishers.Wyoming_vs_Montana: Wyoming more open sagebrush basins. Montana has more dramatic mountain scenery and greener valleys. Wyoming route signs use WY prefix.
state_distinguishers.Colorado_vs_Wyoming: Colorado has more ski resort infrastructure visible. Colorado vegetation greener. Denver urban area distinctive.
state_distinguishers.Idaho_vs_Montana: Idaho has more agricultural valley feel. Montana more wilderness.

regions.route_sign_clues: Wyoming WY prefix. Montana MT. Colorado CO. Idaho ID. All use standard US highway sign formats.
regions.gemini_hint: Open sagebrush basin with distant mountains = likely Wyoming or Montana. WY-XXX marking = Wyoming confirmed.

regions.name: Deep South
visual_identifiers: live oak trees with wide canopy
red clay soil visible in places

state_distinguishers.Louisiana_vs_Mississippi: Louisiana has more bayou/swamp environments. New Orleans-style architecture distinctive. Mississippi more agricultural.
state_distinguishers.Georgia_vs_South_Carolina: Very similar. Georgia has more red clay roads. Coastal South Carolina has distinctive low country feel.

regions.route_sign_clues: Louisiana signs have distinctive pelican. Georgia uses peach outline shape historically.
regions.gemini_hint: Spanish moss on oak trees = Deep South almost certainly. Bayou swamp = Louisiana. Red clay roads = Georgia or Alabama.

regions.name: Northeast
visual_identifiers: dense older towns with narrow roads

state_distinguishers.Maine_vs_Vermont: Maine more coastal feel, lobster infrastructure. Vermont more inland dairy farming, distinctive green hills.
state_distinguishers.New_York_vs_Pennsylvania: New York has distinctive yellow road markings. Pennsylvania uses specific green signs.

regions.route_sign_clues: New York uses distinctive yellow and black signs for state routes. Massachusetts uses a pilgrim hat shape historically.
regions.gemini_hint: Stone walls + white church steeple + hardwood forests = New England. Yellow state route signs = New York.

regions.name: Southeast
visual_identifiers: Florida: palm trees, very flat, subtropical
Tennessee/Kentucky: rolling green hills, horse farms
Virginia: mix of Appalachian and coastal plain

state_distinguishers.Florida_vs_everywhere: Florida is unmistakable: completely flat, palm trees, subtropical vegetation, specific highway infrastructure.
state_distinguishers.North_vs_South_Carolina: Very similar. Look for route sign prefixes NC vs SC.

regions.route_sign_clues: Florida uses distinctive green signs. Tennessee uses specific shield shape.
regions.gemini_hint: Completely flat + palm trees = Florida almost certainly. Horse farms with white fencing = Kentucky or Virginia.

regions.name: Midwest
visual_identifiers: mix of corn and soybean fields
Great Lakes proximity in northern states

state_distinguishers.Michigan_vs_Wisconsin: Michigan has Upper Peninsula wilderness. Wisconsin more dairy farm feel. Both have Great Lakes access.
state_distinguishers.Illinois_vs_Indiana: Illinois has Chicago urban influence spreading outward. Indiana more rural agricultural.

regions.route_sign_clues: Illinois uses distinctive highway marker. Michigan uses specific diamond shape for some routes.
regions.gemini_hint: Flat corn/soybean fields = Midwest corn belt (Illinois, Indiana, Ohio, Iowa). Great Lakes visible = Michigan or Wisconsin.

regions.name: Texas
visual_identifiers: massive wide highways with specific green signs
mix of terrain from east piney woods to west desert
distinctive brown highway signs in Hill Country
very large ranch properties with specific fencing

state_distinguishers.East_Texas: Piney woods, similar to Deep South

regions.route_sign_clues: Texas uses distinctive black and white highway markers. TX prefix on state routes.
regions.gemini_hint: Texas is large enough to look like many regions. Distinctive large green highway signs with TX prefix = Texas confirmed.

regions.name: California
visual_identifiers: specific blue and yellow Caltrans highway signs
palm trees in southern urban areas

state_distinguishers.Northern_vs_Southern: North has redwoods and fog. South has palm trees and desert. Central Valley is flat agricultural.

regions.route_sign_clues: California uses distinctive blue/yellow highway signs. CA or Hwy prefix.
regions.gemini_hint: Blue and yellow highway signs = California. Redwood forest = Northern California coast.
